hero.label: About Sembule Media
hero.title: Local production experience. A wider view of every story.
hero.description: Based in Bunamwaya, Kampala, Sembule Media works with events, organizations and communities across Uganda.

story.label: Since 2022
story.title: Bring the production together, so people can stay with the moment.
paragraphs: Sembule Media was established in 2022 to provide live video production, streaming, sound and PA, photography, videography and documentary services.
From conferences and hybrid events to weddings and field stories, the work begins by understanding the room, the audience and what should be remembered.
story.imageAlt: A live production taking place at an event

values.title: Deliver with clarity

coverage.label: Where we work
coverage.title: Based in Kampala. Available for productions across Uganda.
coverage.description: Tell us where your event or story is taking place and what you need produced. We’ll confirm availability and logistics with you.

statement.description: Livestreaming, sound, event photography and documentary work are connected by the same essentials: clear preparation, capable coordination and an agreed delivery.

hero.label: Sembule Media services
hero.title: Production support for the moments that matter.
hero.description: From the first sound check to the final edit, bring your event or story to a crew that can shape the whole production.

items.title: Livestreaming & broadcast
items.description: Multi-camera event coverage, live switching, broadcast support and recording for in-person and hybrid audiences.

items.title: Sound & PA
items.description: Sound reinforcement and event crew for indoor and outdoor venues. We’ll scope the setup around your space and audience.

items.title: Corporate events
items.description: Production support for conferences, meetings, launches, workshops and gatherings that need clear sound and dependable coverage.

items.title: Weddings & celebrations
items.description: Photography and film for a day you want to experience fully and return to afterwards.

items.title: Photography & videography
items.description: Event and production photography, video coverage and edited deliverables shaped around your brief.

items.title: Documentaries & field stories
items.description: Story-led filming and post-production for organizations, communities and the people behind the work.

items.title: Podcast production
items.description: Recording and production support for a conversation that needs to sound as considered as it feels.

items.title: 65-inch TV display hire
items.description: Display hire for suitable events and venues. Availability, transport and setup are confirmed with each enquiry.
